d: A Trans Bharat Aviation helicopter carrying six people, one pilot and five passengers crashed near Joshimath while en route from Badrinath to Sahastradhara, Dehradun. Contact was lost over the Joshimath valley amid adverse weather conditions, including rain and snowfall in the region.
